page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. This instance features 96 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor and does not include any local storage or integrated GPU hardware.

Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 80 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput data transfers. A key architectural tradeoff of this instance is the lack of hyperthreading, meaning each of the 96 vCPUs maps directly to a dedicated physical core. Additionally, the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses or local NVMe storage, requiring external block storage attachment for persistent data.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation and high-density memory configuration offer predictable performance without resource contention. This makes the instance suitable for enterprise workloads requiring consistent CPU execution, such as database hosting, large-scale web serving, CI/CD pipelines, and general-purpose enterprise applications that do not require GPU acceleration.
